csv_project_name: DB for Coliseum & Arts Center Resurface & Site Improvement
csv_scope_of_work: Resurfacing multiple parking lots and roadways surrounding the North Charleston Coliseum and Performing Arts Center. Parking lot and roadway areas will be separated by sections and constructed in phases to maintain partial site access and minimize disruptions to scheduled events at each venue. The contract also includes the conversion of an existing gravel lot into a fully improved parking facility under a design-build delivery method including but not limited to asphalt pavement, curbing, and drainage infrastructure. The work will need to be coordinated with the City of North Charleston to accommodate upcoming events at the surrounding venues during the entire length of the contract.
